modules.title: 导出和导入各发生了什么

items.title: 导出（Export）：数据变成文件
items.text: 列表里的记录被整批写成 CSV 或 Excel 文件，下载后可以用别的软件打开、修改、存档。

items.title: 导入（Import）：文件变回记录
items.text: 选一个符合格式的文件，工具把里面的每一行变成一条记录。导入前要确认表头和字段对得上。

items.title: 它是扩展功能
items.text: 增删改查操作单条记录，导入导出搬运整批数据。跟 AI 划范围时说清楚这轮做不做，免得工具越做越大。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 导出不是分享链接：链接只是入口，文件才是数据本身。导入会新增或覆盖记录，操作前最好先备份，或让 AI 加一步「先预览要导入多少行」。解决乱码时跟 AI 说「导出用 UTF-8，带 BOM」——BOM 是文件开头的一个小标记，帮 Excel 认出这是 UTF-8。

lessonPractice.title: 会计要拿到这 200 条客户记录、在 Excel 里自己改。下面哪种做法真正把数据交给了她？

options.label: 把记录存成 CSV 文件发给她
options.feedback: 对。导出把数据整批变成一个文件，拿到的是数据本身，可以用 Excel 或别的工具打开。

options.label: 把网页链接发给同事看
options.feedback: 分享链接只是给别人一个访问入口，数据还在原工具里——没有拿到文件。

options.label: 一次性删掉 200 条旧记录
options.feedback: 批量删除是删除的批量版，数据没了而不是搬走了。

en.title: An accountant needs all 200 customer records as a file she can edit in Excel. Which option actually gives her the data?

options.label: Send her the records as a CSV file
options.feedback: Correct. Exporting turns the whole batch into one file you can open in Excel or another tool.

options.label: Sending the web link to a colleague
options.feedback: Sharing a link only grants access; the data stays in the tool and no file changes hands.

options.label: Deleting 200 old records at once
options.feedback: Batch deletion is delete at scale—the data is gone, not moved.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 报价列表加一个「导出 CSV」按钮：导出全部字段，中文用 UTF-8 编码，Excel 打开不乱码。先不做导入，等下一版再说。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add an "Export CSV" button to the quote list: export all fields, UTF-8 encoding so Excel shows Chinese correctly. Skip import until the next round.

learning.assumes: You have opened a spreadsheet file and downloaded attachments.
learning.outcome: You know export hands you the data file itself and import loads a file back in; on garbled text you recognize the encoding problem and ask for a UTF-8 re-export.

modules.title: What happens in export and import

items.title: Export: data becomes a file
items.text: The whole list is written into one CSV or Excel file that other software can open, edit, and archive.

items.title: Import: a file becomes records
items.text: Pick a file in the right format and each row becomes a record. Confirm the headers match your fields first.

items.title: It is an extra feature
items.text: CRUD works record by record; import and export move whole batches. Tell the AI whether this round includes them so the tool does not balloon.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Exporting is not sharing a link: a link is an entrance, a file is the data itself. Importing adds or overwrites records—back up first, or ask the AI for a "preview the rows to import" step. Garbled Chinese in Excel is usually encoding, fixed by asking for UTF-8 with BOM.

distinctions.label: CRUD
distinctions.text: {c:crud} operates on records one at a time; {c:import-export} moves the whole batch as files.

distinctions.label: API
distinctions.text: {c:api} moves data automatically between programs; {c:import-export} moves it manually via files.
